title: Ukwihangana kw'umutima ubabaye
intro: Mu bitabu vy’amateka, hariho umuntu izina ryiwe rihuye n’ukwihangana. Uwo muntu yarageragejwe no gutakaza ihumure ryose ryo mw’isi, yamara yagumye ari umusuku w’Umuremyi yiyemeje. Mu myaka y’ingorane n’ingwara z’umubiri, umutima w’uwo mutima wagumye ushikamye mu kwizera, utanga itara ry’icizigiro ku bantu bose bashikiwe n’ingorane.
clues: Nari umusuku wa Allah yihebeye, nhezagiwe n’ubutunzi bwinshi, abana benshi, n’amagara meza cane.
Ubuzima bwanje bwarahindutse igihe nanyagwa ubutunzi bwanje n’umuryango wanje, nta kindi nsigaye atari ukwizera kwanje.
Nararwaye indwara imara igihe kirekire kandi ibabaza, yagerageza aho ukwihangana kw’umuntu gushika.
Mu mibabaro yanje yose, nanse kwidodombera Umukama wanje, mbere n’igihe umwansi yagerageza kunjana mu kwihebura.
Igihe amaherezo nahamagara Umukama wanje, sinasavye ubutunzi, ahubwo nemeye gusa ko umubabaro wankozeko.
Nabwiwe gukubita ikirenge kw’isi, haca hava isôko ry’amazi akanye yo gukiza umubiri wanje no kumara inyota.
arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
